strategies.title: Habit strategies
strategies.lead: Tried ways that help build good and leave the bad.
strategies.remindHint: At most one reminder a week, on Saturday; turn it off any time.

start-tiny.idea: Start with an amount so small it needs no effort.
start-tiny.example: Two minutes of Quran instead of a whole juz.

anchor-prayer.idea: Place the habit after a set prayer, so the prayer reminds you of it.
anchor-prayer.example: The adhkar right after the Fajr prayer.

if-then.idea: Decide in advance what you will do when the moment comes.
if-then.example: If I miss my wird, then I will read one page before sleep.

prepare-place.idea: Set out what the habit needs before its time.
prepare-place.example: The mushaf on the desk, the prayer mat laid out.

block-sin.idea: Keep the means of the sin out of reach, and make the way to it long.
block-sin.example: Delete the app, and leave the phone outside the room at night.

never-twice.idea: If you miss the habit one day, do not miss it a second day.
never-twice.example: After a missed day, start your day with its smallest amount.

make-up.idea: What you missed yesterday can be made up until Dhuhr the next day.
make-up.example: You missed your night wird, so read it in the forenoon.

bundle.idea: Pair the habit with something you enjoy and look forward to.
bundle.example: Tasbih on your way to work.

season.idea: Seasons of good help a start; hearts are more willing in them.
season.example: Begin fasting Mondays and Thursdays in Shaban.

know-weak.idea: Notice the time, place and state in which you weaken.
know-weak.example: After midnight, when you are alone.

ride-wave.idea: An urge rises and then falls; hold on for a few minutes.
ride-wave.example: Make wudu, or change your place for ten minutes.

follow-good.idea: If you slip, repent, and follow the slip with a good deed at once.
follow-good.example: A small charity or two rakahs after the slip.

company.idea: Keep company that helps you to good, and look in on your friends.
company.example: Agree with a friend on a shared wird.

self-review.idea: Take a minute each evening: what did you keep, and what did you miss?

strategies.deedsLead: Easy good deeds with a great reward. Open one, or make it a habit.

alternative.label: The alternative
alternative.question: What will you do instead next time?
alternative.hint: An act that gives your soul what it asks, in a lawful way.
alternative.example: I leave the phone outside the room, read a little, then sleep

tasbih.title: Make dhikr now
tasbih.timeDone: The ten minutes are over, and you may go on.
tasbih.rewardStart: Each dhikr is a good deed: × {{min}} … up to × {{max}}, if Allah accepts it
tasbih.reward: {{count}} × 10 = {{min}} good deeds … up to {{count}} × 700 = {{max}}, if Allah accepts them

wird.title: A shorter wird
wird.lead: A little today is better than none. Log a smaller amount of your habits.
wird.sittingBody: A voluntary prayer sitting has half the reward of standing, and it is better than leaving it.
